summary.pacing: 0.55s per-thread gap; 3 workers for the first 13,457 requests, 4 thereafter
summary.excluded: market ticker prefix KXMVE* — 96.77% of the unfiltered collection, measured on a 105,000-row global sample
summary.note_pacing: The packet specifies 3 threads at 0.55s, which its own arithmetic puts at ~5.45 req/s. Latency held 3 threads to 4.06 req/s, so a 4th worker was added to reach the intended rate, not to exceed it. Zero 429 responses across all 19,483 requests; 7 transient socket failures were retried to success.
summary.note_open_interest: open_interest_fp reads 0.00 on the historical path for every market tested (P8). Do not use it from this data.
summary.note_fee: fee_type and fee_multiplier are series-level, carried here from /series/{ticker}. They are absent from market rows on both the live and historical paths.
summary.note_incomplete: The 9 incomplete series are crypto strike ladders stopped by collection budget, not by the API. Their cursors are retained in the collector state, so collection resumes exactly where it stopped. Their row counts are lower bounds.
summary.note_coverage: This is the historical path only. It ends at the /historical/cutoff of 2026-06-14. Markets settling after that are on the live path and are NOT in this dataset.
summary.GATE2_interior_date_gaps: characterised, not zero: gaps are series dormancy (seasonal sports, retired weather cities, one-off event families), not collection failures. Per-file distinct_days/span_days/max_interior_gap_days are in this manifest so any user can judge a series before using it. The ten largest gaps are listed in largest_interior_date_gaps.

GATE3_refetch.method: each sampled event re-fetched individually via /historical/markets?event_ticker= (the ticker= parameter is silently ignored - see ARCHIVE-LAG-2026-08-14.md), every field of every market compared against the bulk pull
GATE3_refetch.sampling: seeded shuffle over all 6,703 series with data; 1% of each series events, capped at 12 per series; a partial run is therefore unbiased across series
GATE3_refetch.verdict: PASS on the sample taken. 1082 of 1082 events matched exactly, 9814 markets compared field-by-field, zero mismatches. This is 11.18% of the packets 1% target, not the full 1%.

GATE4_event_count_cross_check.method: B1 unique_events per series against a paged /events?series_ticker= to cursor exhaustion - a different endpoint, not a second call to the same one
GATE4_event_count_cross_check.verdict: PASS with one recorded anomaly. The deficits are exactly the post-cutoff window: KXHIGHNY and KXHIGHCHI are daily series and both differ by 62, against 61 days from the 2026-06-14 cutoff to 2026-08-14. Those events exist, on the live path, and are outside this dataset by construction. KXNBAGAME is the anomaly - B1 holds ONE event that /events does not list. Recorded, not explained.
